# Code of Conduct

## Our Standard

We want Patina to be a welcoming and constructive project for users, contributors, and maintainers.

When participating in this project, please:

- Be respectful and professional.
- Assume good intent, but accept feedback when impact is harmful.
- Focus on technical discussion and actionable collaboration.
- Be considerate of different experience levels, identities, and backgrounds.

Unacceptable behavior includes:

- Harassment, threats, or intimidation
- Personal attacks, insults, or discriminatory language
- Publishing private information without permission
- Repeatedly derailing discussions or spamming project channels

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to project spaces such as issues, pull requests, review comments, and other repository-linked discussions.

## Reporting

If you experience or witness behavior that violates this Code of Conduct, contact the project maintainers privately through GitHub rather than escalating publicly.

When making a report, include:

- What happened
- Where it happened
- Links or screenshots if available
- Any immediate safety or moderation concerns

Maintainers will review reports in good faith and may remove, edit, or moderate content as needed to keep the project welcoming and productive.
